Prevention: Proper site selection (select fallow lands with high vegetation)
Proper land preparation (brushing, felling trees, clearing or burning, ploughing, harrowing)
Effective hand weeding or herbicide application removes beetles habitat.
Timely hand weeding (3-5 weeks after planting); Hand weeding should be done twice, whilst rice selective herbicide must be sprayed once.
Monitoring: Pay regular visits to detect pest damage early
Observe the change in colour of rice leaves (from green to white strips; 2-3 weeks)
Look underneath the leaves for beetle eggs or larvae
Take action when signs of beetles are discovered
Direct Control: Check for beetles with fewer numbers of spots on the back, normally not more than 4 (these are predators and do not harm the plants)
Restrictions: II (moderately hazardous); At two week (split) intervals; Apply in the evening or early in the morning when adult beetles are active; Pre-harvest interval:
You are to harvest at the earliest two weeks after application of insecticides
